weather_alert.description:
Excessive Heat Warning issued July 29 at 4:00AM CDT by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX

* WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with heat index values up to 116 expected.

* WHERE...All of the San Antonio metro.

* WHEN...Through the week; duration under review.

* IMPACTS...Extreme heat significantly increases the potential for heat-related illnesses.

weather_alert.summary: Flood Warning — Bexar, Comal +2 more, through Thursday
weather_alert.description:
Flood Warning issued July 29 at 5:12AM CDT until July 30 at 10:00AM CDT by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX

* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Bexar, Comal, Guadalupe and Kendall counties.

* WHEN...Until 10:00 AM CDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Low-water crossings and creeks out of their banks.

Heat Advisory issued July 29 at 3:30AM CDT until July 29 at 8:00PM CDT by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX

* WHAT...Heat index values from 106 to 110 expected.

* WHERE...The Coastal Plains and portions of the Rio Grande Plains.

* WHEN...From noon to 8 PM CDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures and high humidity may cause heat illnesses.

are_you_ok.title: Cooling centers open across Bexar County as heat wave intensifies
are_you_ok.summary: The county opened extended-hours cooling centers ahead of a dangerous stretch of heat.
are_you_ok.description: Bexar County extended cooling-center hours and posted locations as heat index values climb toward record territory this week.
